project_info.theme: Lixibox Sundate Energy resort lounge GWP poster

main_subject.detail: Summer resort campaign poster featuring a woman reclining on a white sunbed beside a pool, wearing a white swimsuit and a glowing pink LED face mask, posed diagonally across the frame.

Background is a bright resort pool scene with blue water and warm deck materials. Surrounding elements: top-left small white header 'LIXIBOX GWP Gift with Purchase Sundate Energy', large lower-left text 'Mua mặt nạ ánh sáng 6 triệu', and large lower-right orange text 'Nhận quà 7 triệu'. Technical style: photorealistic advertising photography, natural sunlight, bright midday poolside shadows and vivid water highlights, 8k resolution, highly detailed.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Use refs for the reclining model, the LED mask, and the exact text layout. Keep the diagonal sunbed composition with the pool occupying the upper-right area and the promotional text anchored across the lower third. The image should feel aspirational and sunlit rather than clinical.
